title: Opposition anti-government protest after Salianji prison sentence
reason: The reported event occurred outside the assigned month and year.
notes: TRT Balkan body (S008) lacks a visible date but describes the same Tirana protest as Anadolu Agency’s Anews report (S010). Anews was published 8 October 2024 and says the protest occurred Monday, 7 October 2024. The stories appear to be an agency/same-story variant, not independent confirmation. Attendance is unreported; excluded on date alone.
